result.summary: The page appears mostly well-designed and functional. However, there is a minor layout issue where the last visible restaurant card is cut off at the bottom of the screen, indicating incomplete content display.

issues.description: The last restaurant card (pizza image with -20% badge) is cut off at the bottom of the viewport, suggesting the user cannot see the full content without scrolling.
issues.suggestion: Ensure sufficient bottom padding or adjust the layout so that content is not abruptly cut off at the bottom edge of the screen.
